title: WorkerResult
description: Untrusted Worker execution output. NOT Observation, Artifact, Evidence, Candidate, Finding, or Hypothesis outcome. EXECUTION_FAILED is not Hypothesis REJECTED. raw_result and descriptors are not Transition A records.

worker_id.description: Opaque Worker runtime identity (Decision 015). Not Core. Not authorization.

status.description: Execution status. Not Hypothesis outcome. Not Evidence.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timezone-aware timestamp string. Transport-neutral. Not a database timestamptz type. format enforcement depends on a later validator decision.

completed_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timezone-aware timestamp string. Transport-neutral. Not a database timestamptz type. format enforcement depends on a later validator decision.

raw_result.description: Untrusted execution payload. MUST NOT carry authorization, budget authority, Evidence, Finding, or Approval.

items.description: Untrusted descriptor of produced bytes. NOT an Artifact SoR record.

raw_artifact_descriptors.description: Not Artifact identity/metadata in PostgreSQL. Transition A creates Artifacts later.

diagnostics.description: Untrusted diagnostics. Not AuditEvent. Not truth. MUST NOT contain secret values.

control_signal.description: Optional untrusted control/debug bag. Not an authorization decision. Reauthorization uses ReauthorizationRequest.

ephemeral_secrets.description: Ephemeral secret material from execution. Ingest MUST strip this object before persistence.
